notes_for_editor: Build data rests on the county survey and the statewide list, which agree on 1938, tower 36 and the stairway design. No removal date or fate source beyond the FFLA 'Gone' entry; no source describes the site today. The 'Long Lake tower' name is unresolved and may be another name for Glen or an earlier tower. FFLA coordinates (46.46321, -93.51296) differ trivially from the survey's (46.4632, -93.5126). Possible follow-up: Minnesota DNR forestry records and Aitkin County newspaper archives.
